name: Cheap-tier-first campaign with per-tier output-validity gates
description: Order an expensive, metered investigation so cheap filters run first and every expensive tier is entered only on survivors. The transferable idea is the INPUT/OUTPUT guard split: a preflight guards what goes in, and a separate validity gate guards what comes out, because a candidate can score well and still be an impossible result. The funnel also validates itself: a correlation probe on a held-out sample can declare the cheap tier uninformative, in which case the funnel is reported WORTHLESS rather than assumed useful.

candidates.description: The candidate set entering the cheap tier. A single-item question has no funnel.

cheap_tier.description: The cheap filter: its name, unit cost and expected filter strength.

expensive_tier.description: The metered or licence-gated tier. Entered only by survivors.

budget_usd.description: Hard cost ceiling. Fanning out a metered tier without one is how credits vanish.

target_survivors.description: Stop when the funnel is narrow enough to answer the question.

correlation_holdout.description: How many candidates go through BOTH tiers regardless of the cheap verdict, so the correlation can be measured.

backend_credential.description: Reference NAME of the metered backend credential. The value never enters an artifact, a log, an export bundle or the replay journal.

preflight-guard.description: Guards the INPUT: rejects malformed or out-of-domain candidates before any tier is paid for.

tier-runner.description: Invokes a tier backend for one candidate and records its cost.

validity-auditor.description: Guards the OUTPUT: a good SCORE is not a valid RESULT. Holds a veto on tier promotion.

owner.description: The human owner - the only role that may authorise spending against the metered tier.

routes.reason: the output-validity veto must not be held by the same vendor that produced the score

stages.title: S0 - guard the INPUT before anything is paid for

work_unit.title: Preflight every candidate against the tier's input domain
work_unit.question_or_target: Reject malformed and out-of-domain candidates before any metered call, and record why each was rejected so the funnel's input loss is auditable rather than invisible.

assigned_model_vendor_role.basis: deciding what is in-domain requires the backend's contract, which is judgement not a regex

work_unit.evidence_requirement: a per-candidate admit/reject decision with the domain rule cited for every rejection
tests_required: a candidate the backend cannot accept is rejected BEFORE the tier runs
both-states control: a valid candidate is admitted, proving the guard is not rejecting everything
work_unit.reviewer_requirement: the validity-auditor, who checks that no rejection is a silent drop
work_unit.completion_sentinel: SUCCESS:DAT-7501 emitted only when every candidate carries an admit or reject decision with a cited rule; otherwise FAILED:DAT-7501 <reason>
work_unit.retry_policy: two strikes then pivot to a narrower declared domain
work_unit.mechanism: input-domain preflight, distinct from and prior to every output-validity gate

stages.title: No metered call until the input guard passes
S1 - the cheap tier over ALL admitted candidates

body.title: Score one candidate on the cheap tier

work_unit.title: Run the cheap tier for one candidate and record its unit cost
work_unit.question_or_target: Produce a cheap-tier score for one candidate and record the actual cost incurred, so cost per surviving candidate can be computed rather than estimated.

assigned_model_vendor_role.basis: the call is mechanical; interpreting a backend error as retryable or terminal is not

work_unit.evidence_requirement: the score, the backend invocation identifier, and the measured cost - never an assumed cost
tests_required: a backend error is classified as retryable or terminal and never recorded as a score of zero
the recorded cost is the measured one; a cache hit records cost zero and says so
work_unit.completion_sentinel: SUCCESS:DAT-7502 emitted only when a score and a measured cost exist for this candidate, or a classified failure does; otherwise FAILED:DAT-7502 <reason>
work_unit.retry_policy: exponential, three attempts on a transient backend error only
work_unit.mechanism: cheap-tier scoring with measured per-call cost accounting

stages.title: S2 - a good SCORE is not a valid RESULT: gate the cheap tier's OUTPUT

work_unit.title: Validate every cheap-tier result for structural or physical possibility
work_unit.question_or_target: Reject results that score well but are impossible under the domain's own constraints, so an impossible candidate cannot earn an expensive tier.

assigned_model_vendor_role.basis: a same-vendor reviewer shares the scorer's blind spots, so the output veto is cross-vendor

work_unit.evidence_requirement: for each rejected result, the specific constraint it violates - not a confidence score
tests_required: a candidate that scores in the top decile and violates a hard domain constraint is REJECTED
both-states control: a valid top-decile candidate is not rejected, so the gate is not simply discarding high scores
work_unit.reviewer_requirement: the preflight-guard, cross-examining whether a rejection is really an OUTPUT problem and not an input one it should have caught
work_unit.completion_sentinel: SUCCESS:DAT-7503 emitted only when every cheap-tier result carries a validity verdict with a cited constraint for each rejection; otherwise FAILED:DAT-7503 <reason>
work_unit.retry_policy: none: a validity verdict is a conclusion
work_unit.mechanism: output-validity audit that can reject a high-scoring result on a domain constraint
work_unit.not_a_duplicate_because: the preflight guards the INPUT domain; this guards the OUTPUT, and a result can pass one and fail the other

stages.title: Only valid cheap-tier results earn the next tier
S2b - is the cheap tier informative at all, or is the funnel worthless

work_unit.title: Measure cheap-vs-expensive rank correlation on a held-out sample
work_unit.question_or_target: Push correlation_holdout candidates through BOTH tiers regardless of the cheap verdict and measure rank correlation, so the funnel's usefulness is measured rather than assumed.

assigned_model_vendor_role.basis: choosing a holdout that is not biased by the cheap score is a sampling judgement

work_unit.evidence_requirement: the holdout membership, both tiers' ranks for each member, the correlation coefficient and its confidence interval
tests_required: a cheap tier with zero correlation to the expensive one yields a WORTHLESS funnel verdict rather than a silent pass
the holdout includes candidates the cheap tier REJECTED, or the correlation is measured only on candidates the cheap tier already liked and is circular
work_unit.reviewer_requirement: the validity-auditor, who checks the holdout is not conditioned on the cheap score
work_unit.completion_sentinel: SUCCESS:DAT-7504 emitted only when a correlation coefficient with an interval is recorded on a holdout that includes cheap-tier rejects; otherwise FAILED:DAT-7504 <reason>
work_unit.retry_policy: fixed, two attempts on backend unavailability
work_unit.mechanism: held-out cheap-vs-expensive rank-correlation probe that can declare the funnel worthless

stages.title: An uninformative cheap tier means the funnel is discarding good candidates
Owner authorisation before the metered tier fans out
stages.prompt: The cheap tier left N survivors and the measured cheap-vs-expensive correlation is R. Authorise spending up to budget_usd on the metered tier, reduce the budget, or stop with the cheap-tier result?

stages.title: S3 - the metered tier over SURVIVORS ONLY

body.title: Run the metered tier for one survivor

work_unit.title: Run the expensive tier for one surviving candidate under the cost ceiling
work_unit.question_or_target: Invoke the metered backend for one survivor, charge it against the remaining budget, and halt the tier the moment the ceiling is reached rather than after it is exceeded.

assigned_model_vendor_role.basis: cost-ceiling arithmetic is mechanical; deciding whether a partial result is usable is not

work_unit.evidence_requirement: the backend run id, the measured cost, and the remaining budget after the call - the credential is referenced by NAME and never recorded
tests_required: the tier stops at the budget ceiling with survivors unprocessed listed as UNEVALUATED, not as failed
the secret_ref value never appears in the artifact, the log or the replay journal
work_unit.completion_sentinel: SUCCESS:DAT-7505 emitted only when a result and a measured cost exist, or the candidate is recorded UNEVALUATED with the budget state that caused it; otherwise FAILED:DAT-7505 <reason>
work_unit.retry_policy: exponential, two attempts, transient backend errors only - a retry spends real money
work_unit.mechanism: survivors-only metered execution with a hard cost ceiling and UNEVALUATED accounting

stages.title: S4 - gate the expensive tier's OUTPUT too, on the same principle

work_unit.title: Validate every expensive-tier result and compute cost per surviving candidate
work_unit.question_or_target: Apply the same output-validity standard to the expensive tier and report cost per ACCEPTED result, so the funnel's economics are visible instead of implied.

assigned_model_vendor_role.basis: cross-vendor output veto at every tier, not only the cheap one

work_unit.evidence_requirement: per-result validity verdicts plus total spend divided by accepted results, with UNEVALUATED candidates excluded from the denominator and counted separately
tests_required: an impossible high-scoring expensive result is rejected
cost per survivor excludes UNEVALUATED candidates from the denominator, so a truncated run does not flatter the economics
work_unit.completion_sentinel: SUCCESS:DAT-7506 emitted only when every expensive result has a validity verdict and cost per accepted result is recorded; otherwise FAILED:DAT-7506 <reason>
work_unit.retry_policy: none: a validity verdict is a conclusion about a result, not an operation to repeat
work_unit.mechanism: second output-validity gate plus cost-per-accepted-result economics

stages.title: The funnel never reports survivors it did not validate
S5 - report cost per surviving candidate and the tier ledger

work_unit.title: Emit the per-tier entered/survived/cost ledger
work_unit.question_or_target: State for each tier how many candidates entered, how many survived, what it cost, and what the funnel would have cost unfunnelled - the comparison that decides whether the funnel earned its complexity.

assigned_model_vendor_role.basis: the economic comparison is the deliverable and is authored by a role with no stake in the tiers

work_unit.evidence_requirement: entered, survived and measured cost per tier, plus the counterfactual unfunnelled cost computed from the expensive tier's unit cost times the admitted candidate count
tests_required: the unfunnelled counterfactual is computed, so a funnel that saved nothing is visible
validity_failures are reported as their own count and never folded into survivors
work_unit.reviewer_requirement: one independent adversarial reviewer in a fresh context who recomputes the arithmetic
work_unit.completion_sentinel: SUCCESS:DAT-7507 emitted only when per-tier counts, measured costs and the unfunnelled counterfactual are all present and reconcile; otherwise FAILED:DAT-7507 <reason>
work_unit.retry_policy: none: a cost-per-survivor reconciliation failure is the finding, not a transient error
work_unit.mechanism: per-tier economics with an explicit unfunnelled counterfactual

impact.blast_radius: spends real credits and licence tokens against a metered backend; artifacts stay under the campaign root

worked_example.scenario: Rank 4,000 ligands against one receptor. The cheap tier is a GPU-Vina screen at $0.004/candidate; the expensive tier is a licence-token-gated FEP run at $9.50/candidate.
expected_trace: preflight-inputs -> 3,961 admitted, 39 rejected out-of-domain (cited rule per rejection)
cheap-validity -> 114 top-decile poses REJECTED for a hard geometry violation; a score-only funnel would have promoted them at $9.50 each
correlation-probe -> Spearman 0.61 on a 24-candidate holdout that INCLUDES cheap-tier rejects
spend-approval -> owner authorises the full budget
expensive-tier -> 118 survivors, 118 runs, $1,121; barrier quorum 0.6 met
expensive-validity -> 6 invalid; cost per accepted result = $1,121 / 112 = $10.01
cost-report -> unfunnelled counterfactual 3,961 x $9.50 = $37,630 versus $1,137 actual

bp7.unverified: UNVERIFIED outside chemistry - the pattern currently exists only inside the compchem skills, and confidence that it transfers cleanly is only likely (55-80%). Settling experiment = run the funnel on a paid research campaign and measure cost per accepted result against an unfunnelled arm; the correlation-probe stage exists so that experiment is part of the workflow rather than external to it.

distinct_from.BP-PDS-04: that one paces AGENT quota across subscriptions; this orders an INVESTIGATION's tiers by cost
distinct_from.bp-dat-05: that one runs a FIXED case set hermetically for a pass rate; this narrows a candidate set under a spend ceiling
distinct_from.bp-dat-02: bounds by tokens with no notion of cost, tiers, or survivors

bp7.flagship_rationale: NOT flagship: its load-bearing claim (the pattern transfers outside chemistry) is UNVERIFIED at likely 55-80%, and an end-to-end test would need a metered backend this repo does not have. The structural properties (a validity gate between every tier pair, cost-per-survivor arithmetic) ARE asserted by test_bp7_slice.py.
